name: +1 IQ Every Step  🧠[UPD]
desc:
+1 IQ every Step 🧠
🚶 Walk through the world and gain IQ with every step!
📚 Buy books to boost your IQ gain to insane levels!
⚔️ Defeat 14 enemies – from a Baby all the way to the Mega Mind!
🏆 Collect Wins and unlock new areas!
🔁 Rebirth to gain even more power and go beyond your limits!
🤖 Use AutoFarm to keep progressing even while AFK!
🍹 Activate drink boosts for crazy temporary multipliers!
🎁 Claim daily gifts and exclusive rewards every day!
Can you defeat Mega Mind with 2.5 Trillion IQ? 🤯

💛 This game was made by a solo developer! Every bit of support means the world and directly helps fund new updates, more content and a better experience for everyone. If you enjoy the game, consider supporting – it truly makes a huge difference! And also give a Feedback if you want🙏
